// Test-owned fixture of tests/admin_audit_attribution_test.cjs (not product code): the failure classes of Astra
// S7-U3a-E-R-001 F01-F03 — a member reached by a constant key missing from the call and write tracking, a WITH fragment
// written or handed on, a readonly field's object handed on — and the same rule over every object (e) and F03 read
// values out of: an instance, a class, an enum, a fragment. Same format and use as
// tests/fixtures/admin_audit_completeness/violations.txt: every case is a module of its own put next to the baseline
// fixture there, and must fail the gate on exactly the class its header names, on exactly the candidates its lines mark.
//   // ==== case: <name> | verdict: <class> [entries] [| table: +row <action> | table: +wildcard <stem>] ====

// ==== case: e-f01-a-helper-called-by-a-constant-key-with-a-request-value | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
const GO = 'go';
export class SynHelper {
  private go(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    return tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', action, target: 'syn' } }); // expect: unresolved `body.kind` is a property the program does not fix
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
    await this.go(tx, 'syn.allowed');
    await this[GO](tx, body.kind);
  }
}

// ==== case: e-f01-a-helper-object-read-by-an-unfixed-key | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynHelper {
  private go(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, action: string) {
    return tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', action, target: 'syn' } }); // expect: unresolved which is read by a key the program does not fix
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
    await this.go(tx, 'syn.allowed');
    await (this as any)[body.method](body.db, body.kind); // expect: proven_non_audit no client value reaches
  }
}

// ==== case: e-f01-a-with-fragment-helper-called-by-a-constant-key | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
const LINK = 'linked';
export class SynPaths {
  private async linked(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, selector: Prisma.Sql) {
    await tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT t.uid FROM "StudyState" t WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) SELECT ${actor}, 'syn.allowed', uid FROM s`; // expect: unresolved `body.where` is not a Prisma.sql text
  }
  async fixed(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, uid: string) { await this.linked(tx, actor, Prisma.sql`t.uid = ${uid}::text`); }
  async unfixed(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, body: any) { await this[LINK](tx, actor, body.where); }
}

// ==== case: e-f01-a-readonly-field-written-by-a-constant-key | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
const KEY = 'field';
export class SynReadonly {
  private readonly field = 'syn.allowed';
  change(body: any) { (this as any)[KEY] = body.kind; }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) {
    await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', target: 'syn', action: this.field } }); // expect: unresolved is written at
  }
}

// ==== case: e-f01-an-enum-member-written-by-a-constant-key | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
enum Kind { Allowed = 'syn.allowed' }
const KEY = 'Allow' + 'ed';
export async function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, body: any) {
  (Kind as any)[KEY] = body.kind;
  await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', target: 'syn', action: Kind.Allowed } }); // expect: unresolved is written at
}

// ==== case: e-f02-a-fragment-written-through-a-member | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, uid: string, body: any) {
  const selector = Prisma.sql`uid = ${uid}::text`;
  (selector as any).strings[0] = body.sql;
  return tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT uid FROM "StudyState" WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (action) SELECT 'syn.allowed' FROM s`; // expect: unresolved holds an SQL fragment that is written at
}

// ==== case: e-f02-a-fragment-handed-to-an-outside-function | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
declare function opaque(value: unknown): void;
export function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, uid: string) {
  const selector = Prisma.sql`uid = ${uid}::text`;
  opaque(selector);
  return tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT uid FROM "StudyState" WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (action) SELECT 'syn.allowed' FROM s`; // expect: unresolved holds an SQL fragment that is handed to `opaque`
}

// ==== case: e-f02-a-fragment-written-through-a-const-alias | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, uid: string, body: any) {
  const selector = Prisma.sql`uid = ${uid}::text`;
  const same = selector;
  (same as any).strings[0] = body.sql;
  return tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT uid FROM "StudyState" WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (action) SELECT 'syn.allowed' FROM s`; // expect: unresolved holds an SQL fragment that is written at
}

// ==== case: e-f02-a-fragment-written-by-a-local-helper | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
function widen(fragment: Prisma.Sql, sql: string) { (fragment as any).strings[0] = sql; }
export function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, uid: string, body: any) {
  const selector = Prisma.sql`uid = ${uid}::text`;
  widen(selector, body.sql);
  return tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT uid FROM "StudyState" WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (action) SELECT 'syn.allowed' FROM s`; // expect: unresolved holds an SQL fragment that is written at
}

// ==== case: e-f02-a-fragment-parameter-handed-on-in-its-helper | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
declare function opaque(value: unknown): void;
export class SynPaths {
  private async linked(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, selector: Prisma.Sql) {
    opaque(selector);
    await tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT t.uid FROM "StudyState" t WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (actor, action, target) SELECT ${actor}, 'syn.allowed', uid FROM s`; // expect: unresolved holds an SQL fragment that is handed to `opaque`
  }
  async fixed(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, actor: string, uid: string) { await this.linked(tx, actor, Prisma.sql`t.uid = ${uid}::text`); }
}

// ==== case: e-f02-a-fragment-part-handed-on | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
declare function opaque(value: unknown): void;
export function run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, uid: string) {
  const selector = Prisma.sql`uid = ${uid}::text`;
  opaque((selector as any).values);
  return tx.$executeRaw`WITH s AS (SELECT uid FROM "StudyState" WHERE ${selector}) INSERT INTO "AuditLog" (action) SELECT 'syn.allowed' FROM s`; // expect: unresolved holds an SQL fragment that is handed on at
}

// ==== case: e-f03-a-readonly-field-object-handed-to-an-outside-function | verdict: unresolved ====

    opaque(this);

  }
}

// ==== case: e-f03-a-readonly-field-object-behind-an-alias | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynReadonly {
  private readonly field = 'syn.allowed';
  change(body: any) {
    const self = this;
    Object.assign(self, body.patch);
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) {
    await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', target: 'syn', action: this.field } }); // expect: unresolved is a member of an instance of `SynReadonly`, which is handed on at
  }
}

// ==== case: e-f03-a-readonly-field-written-through-an-untyped-alias | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynReadonly {
  private readonly field = 'syn.allowed';
  change(body: any) {
    const self: any = this;
    self.field = body.kind;
  }
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) {
    await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', target: 'syn', action: this.field } }); // expect: unresolved is written at
  }
}

// ==== case: e-f03-an-instance-handed-on-outside-its-class | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
declare function opaque(value: unknown): void;
export class SynReadonly {
  private readonly field = 'syn.allowed';
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) {
    await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', target: 'syn', action: this.field } }); // expect: unresolved is a member of an instance of `SynReadonly`, which is handed on at
  }
}
export function leak() {
  const kept = new SynReadonly();
  opaque(kept);
}

// ==== case: e-f03-a-prototype-reached-through-the-class | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynReadonly {
  private readonly field = 'syn.allowed';
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) {
    await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', target: 'syn', action: this.field } }); // expect: unresolved is reached through `SynReadonly.prototype` at
  }
}
Object.defineProperty(SynReadonly.prototype, 'field', { set() { /* the initializer's value is dropped */ }, get: () => 'syn.other' });

// ==== case: e-f03-a-called-member-that-runs-code-the-check-does-not-read | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
declare function opaque(value: unknown): void;
export class SynReadonly {
  private readonly field = 'syn.allowed';
  private hook: (...values: unknown[]) => void = opaque;
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) {
    this.hook();
    await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', target: 'syn', action: this.field } }); // expect: unresolved which is handed on as `this` of `this.hook`
  }
}

// ==== case: e-f03-a-static-readonly-field-of-a-class-handed-on | verdict: unresolved ====
import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
export class SynStatic {
  private static readonly FIELD = 'syn.allowed';
  async run(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) {
    await tx.auditLog.create({ data: { actor: 'syn', target: 'syn', action: SynStatic.FIELD } }); // expect: unresolved is a member of the class `SynStatic`, which is handed on at
  }
}
export const PROVIDERS = [SynStatic];
